title: Trump's Operation Sindoor claim, and India's answer

scenes.title: Trump's Operation Sindoor claim, and India's answer
scenes.say: Donald Trump has made Operation Sindoor part of his midterm pitch. Here's the claim, and India's answer.

scenes.title: Fort Myers, Florida, 23 October
scenes.say: At a rally in Florida on 23 October, he again said he stopped India and Pakistan from escalating last year's conflict.
scenes.speak: At a rally in Florida on the twenty-third of October, he again said he stopped India and Pakistan from escalating last year's conflict.

scenes.text: I'm going to put massive tariffs on both of you, 250 per cent, so you won't be able to do any business.
scenes.role: Campaign rally, Fort Myers, via PTI
scenes.say: His version: he warned both countries of massive tariffs that would shut them out of trade with America.

scenes.label: tariffs Trump says he threatened India and Pakistan with
scenes.say: 250% tariffs, he says. And, he added, 11 planes were shot, without saying whose.
scenes.speak: Two hundred and fifty per cent tariffs, he says. And, he added, eleven planes were shot, without saying whose.

scenes.title: "Did I get the Nobel Prize? No."
scenes.say: Then the grievance: I've settled 8 wars, he said. Did I get the Nobel Prize? No.
scenes.speak: Then the grievance: I've settled eight wars, he said. Did I get the Nobel Prize? No.

scenes.title: Operation Sindoor, India's account
scenes.say: India's account: after the Pahalgam attack, Operation Sindoor hit terror infrastructure in Pakistan. Action was paused on 10 May at Pakistan's request.
scenes.speak: India's account: after the Pahalgam attack, Operation Sindoor hit terror infrastructure in Pakistan. Action was paused on the tenth of May at Pakistan's request.

scenes.title: Settled directly, no mediator
scenes.say: India has repeatedly rejected Trump's claim. It says the understanding was reached directly between India and Pakistan.

scenes.title: Why India pushes back
items: Tariffs already stall the trade deal
scenes.say: Why it matters: India rejects mediation on Pakistan, tariffs already stall the trade deal, and Washington's politics keep spilling into India's security.
